metadata.source_title: Trade Show Essentials – 10x10, 10x15 & 10x20 Custom Canopy Tents for Events & Exhibits
metadata.source_description:
Trade Show Essentials Collection

Make a lasting impression at your next event with our Tradeshow Essentials Collection, featuring premium Custom Canopy Tent Packages designed for professionals who demand quality, style, and performance.

Each tent in this collection combines durability, easy setup, and full customization, helping your brand stand out at trade shows, exhibitions, and outdoor activations.

💪 Strong HEX Aluminum Frames: Engineered for long-lasting stability and a polished, professional look.

🎨 Vivid Full-Color Printing: High-quality dye-sublimation printing ensures your logo and graphics stay bright and eye-catching.

⚙️ Quick Pop-Up Design: Fast, tool-free setup ideal for busy event schedules.

🧵 Custom Wall Options: Choose from full back walls, half side walls, or complete enclosure packages for maximum branding.

🧳 Wheeled Carry Bags Included: Convenient for transport and storage.

🎁 All Packages Include: Free design service, durable hardware, and fast delivery.

Perfect for trade shows, expos, product demos, and branded outdoor events, our Tradeshow Essentials canopy tents help you look professional and attract attention wherever you go.

products.title: Trade Show Essential 10x10 Custom Canopy Tent – HEX Aluminum Frame, Full Back Wall & Half Side Walls + Flags + Table Cover
products.description:
Specsheet Warning Label Fire Certificate

Trade Show Essential 10x10 Custom Canopy Tent

Make your booth stand out at trade shows, festivals, and outdoor events with our 10x10 Trade Show Essential Custom Canopy Tent. This professional-grade canopy combines durability, branding, and convenient setup, helping you attract more visitors and make a lasting impression.

Key Features:

💪 HEX Aluminum Frame (Silver): Strong and lightweight for reliable stability.

🎨 Custom Printing: Dye-sublimation printing on canopy top, full back wall, and half side walls for vibrant, fade-resistant branding.

🧱 Half Side Walls with Mesh Option: Solid fabric bottoms with optional mesh tops for airflow and customer visibility.

🧵 Full Back Wall: Printed inward for professional interior appearance and brand exposure.

☀️ Weather-Resistant Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester, UV-protected and waterproof.

⚙️ Quick Pop-Up Design: Tool-free assembly allows fast setup in minutes.

🧳 Wheeled Carry Bag Included: Convenient transport and storage for the frame.

🎁 Complete Package: Frame, canopy top, printed walls, wheeled carry bag, free design service, and fast delivery.

- Included Accessories:

- 2-12' Double Sided Stand Alone Flags, Table Cover

- 1- 6' Stretch Table Cover

Materials

- Hardware: ABS Nylon, Aluminum

- Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications

- Meets FR Rating Requirements

Primary Usage

Trade shows, outdoor events, food festivals, farmers’ markets, pop-up shops, and brand activations
